summary.text: Tharon Chandler is an independent candidate for U.S. Senate in Tennessee who also ran as an independent in the 2024 Senate race. A native of Lawrenceburg, Tennessee, and an Army veteran, Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as a journalist, economist, Christian missionary and conservationist.

paragraphs.text: Chandler was born William Tharon Chandler in Lawrenceburg, Tennessee, and graduated from Lawrence County High School.

He served in the U.S. Army in 1991 and earned a bachelor's degree from Memphis State University in 1994. He also completed graduate-level coursework and studied education at the University of Tennessee at Martin, the University of North Alabama and Middle Tennessee State University.
Ballotpedia lists his affiliations as including Gulf War Veterans Against the War, Wounded Warriors, the Fraternal Order of Police and the YMCA.
Chandler ran as an independent in the 2024 U.S. Senate election in Tennessee, receiving 0.9% (28,444 votes) in the general election won by Marsha Blackburn.
